name: Mom
message: I MISS YOU TOO!!! 💕 I can’t wait to see you soon! I hope the rain is kind to you tomorrow, and that all that anxiety goes away once you remember you can conquer it all!

name: Kaderha Baker
message: Since coming across your page on ig when you first started I come here every week to check to see if you’re ok. I really think what you’re doing is so bold and admirable. Keep Going , this is amazing👏🏾🤗.
